data.titulo: Babg 7—A Zezi vʋʋgrã tɛk n tãag b sẽn kẽes a Poll bãensã
data.contenido:
A Zezi kũumã rasem a tãab poore, a vʋʋgame. La baraar bala, a vẽnega a meng naoor a nu t’a karen-​biisã yã-a. Yaa rasem 40 pʋgẽ la a sẽn da vẽnegd a meng t’a karen-​biisã yãt-⁠a wã. Rẽ poore, a zẽkame n dabd saasẽ t’a karen-​biis kẽer getẽ. A Zezi sẽn dʋ saasẽ wã rasem piig poore, Wẽnnaam kɩtame t’a vʋʋsem sõngã sig a karen-​biis nins sẽn da be Zerizalɛm n gũudẽ wã zugu.

Kaoosg zugẽ, neb sẽn ka nong Wẽnnaam n kẽes tʋm-​tʋmdbã bãense, la malɛk n yiis-⁠ba. Neb a taab me n lob karen-​biig a Etɩɛn kug n kʋ. La d na n yãame t’a Zezi yãka ned a yembr sẽn zĩnd a Etɩɛn kʋʋbã zĩigẽ t’a na n lebg a tʋm-​tʋmda. Nin-​kãng yʋʋr la a Polle. D na n yãame me t’a Zezi kũumã yʋʋm a tãab la pʋɩ-​sʋk poore, Wẽnnaam tʋma tʋm-​tʋmd a Pɩɛɛr t’a tɩ moon a Korney ne a zaka rãmb sẽn ka Zʋɩf rãmbã.

Sẽn na maan yʋʋm 13 rẽ loogr poore, a Poll sɩngame n gilgd tẽnsã n moond koe-​noogã. A so-​toak a yiib-⁠n-​soabã, a Tɩmote tũ-a lame. D na n goma a Poll ne a tũud-⁠n-​taasã sẽn paam sũ-noog ning Wẽnnaam tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ wã me yelle. B wa n kẽesa a Poll bãens Rom, n wa yiis-⁠a yʋʋm a yiib poore. B leb n wa kẽes-⁠a-⁠la bãense, la so-​kãngã wã b kʋ-⁠a lame. Babg a yopoe wã pʋgẽ, d na n goma yɛl sẽn maan sẽn kolg yʋʋm 32 pʋgẽ.

YÃMB mii pagã ne rap a yiibã sẽn be foto wã zugã bɩ? Pagã yaa a Maari Madelɛn. A yaa a Zezi karen-​biiga. Rapã sẽn yer fu-​peelsã yaa malɛgse. A Zezi sẽn ki wã, b mum-⁠a-⁠la yaoog sẽn wõnd ro-​bil pʋgẽ n lebs n pag ne kug-​kẽenga. Yaa be la a Maari sẽn lɩkdã. La a mikame tɩ kũumã ka le be yaoogã pʋgẽ ye. A kẽe yɛ?

A Zezi kũumã poore, maan-​kʋʋdbã yeela a Pɩlat yaa: ‘A Zezi sẽn da wa n ket n vɩyã, a yeelame t’a sã n ki a na n vʋʋga rasem a tãab poore. Woto yĩnga, bɩ y kɩt tɩ b gũ yaoogã t’a karen-​biisã ra zuk kũumã n yaool n yeel nebã t’a vʋʋgame ye.’ Rẽ n so t’a Pɩlat yeel maan-​kʋʋdbã tɩ b tʋm sodaas tɩ b tɩ gũ yaoogã.

La a Zezi kũumã rasem a tãab poore, yibeoogã pĩnda, a Zeova malɛk n wa n bilim kugr ning sẽn da pag yaoogã. Sodaas nins sẽn da gũud yaoogã yɛɛsa wʋsg n pa tõe n le maan bũmb ye. La sẽn yɩ bilfu, b wa n lɩka yaoogã pʋgẽ n mik tɩ kũumã ka be ye. Kẽer n kẽe tẽngã pʋgẽ n na n togs maan-​kʋʋdbã. Yãmb mii maan-​kʋʋdbã sẽn maan bũmb ning bɩ? B sẽn yaa wẽnsã yĩnga, b kõo sodaasã ligd la b yeel-⁠b tɩ b yag ziri. B yeela sodaasã yaa: ‘Yeel-⁠y t’a karen-​biisã waa ne yʋng n zuk kũumã yãmb sẽn wa n gõeyã wakate.’

Pagb a taab me sẽn da yaa a Zezi karen-​biis n yõd n wa a Zezi yaoogẽ wã. La b sẽn ta wã, b mikame tɩ yaoogã yaa vɩʋʋgo. A Maari Madelɛn zoeeme n tɩ togs a Pɩɛɛr ne a Zã. La malɛgs a yiib sẽn yer fu-​peels n puk pagb a taabã taoor zĩig pʋgẽ n sok-⁠b yaa: ‘Bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb baood a Zezi ka? A vʋʋgame. Kẽng-⁠y tao-​tao n tɩ togs a karen-​biisã.’ Pagbã zoee tao-​tao n na n kẽnge. La sorã zugu, rao a ye n yals-⁠ba. Yãmb mii sẽn yaa ned ning bɩ? Yaa a Zezi. A yeela pagbã yaa: ‘Kẽng-⁠y n tɩ togs m karen-​biisã tɩ m vʋʋgame.’

Pagbã sẽn tɩ togs karen-​biisã t’a Zezi vʋʋgame la b yã-a lame wã, b pa tẽ ye. A Pɩɛɛr ne a Zã zoeeme n kẽng yaoogẽ wã n na n tɩ ges b toore, la b taame n mik tɩ yaoogã sɩd yaa vɩʋʋgo, tɩ b lebg n looge. A Maari Madelɛn me da lebg n waame, la a kell n paa be. Yaa wakat kãng la a sẽn lɩk yaoogã pʋgẽ n yã malɛgs a yiibã.

La kũumã sẽn da be yaoogã pʋgẽ wã maana wãna? Wẽnnaam kɩtame t’a meneme. Wẽnnaam ka vʋʋg a Zezi ne a pĩnd yĩngã ye. A vʋʋg-⁠a lame t’a lebg malɛka. La wa d sẽn na n yã wã, a Zezi ra pukda ne ninsaal yĩnga, sẽn na yɩl t’a karen-​biisã yã-a n bãng t’a vʋʋgame.Matɩe 27:⁠62-⁠66; 28:​1-⁠15; Luk 24:​1-⁠12; Zã 20:​1-⁠12. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

data.titulo: A kẽe roog sẽn sog pʋgẽ
data.contenido:
A PƖƐƐR ne a Zã sẽn loogã poore, a Maari paa a Zezi yaoogã noor n sɩng yãbre. Wala tõnd sẽn zoe n yã poorẽ wã, a lɩkame n ges yaoogã pʋgẽ n yã malɛgs a yiibu. Malɛgsã sok-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Bõe yĩng tɩ fo yãbda?’

A Maari leokame yaa: ‘B rɩka m Zusoabã tɩ m ka mi b sẽn gãneg-⁠a zĩig ning ye.’ A Maari wẽnegame n yã rao tɩ raoã sok-⁠a yaa: ‘Fo baooda ãnda?’

A Maari ra tẽedame tɩ yaa rao ning sẽn get-⁠a tɩɩsã yellã, la tɩ tõe tɩ yaa yẽ n dɩk kũumã. Rẽ n so t’a yeel raoã yaa: ‘Sã n yaa yãmb n dɩk-⁠a bɩ y wilg maam yãmb sẽn gãneg-⁠a zĩig ninga.’ La rao ning sẽn da gomd ne-⁠a wã yaa a Zezi. A sẽn da pa le wõnd pĩndã yĩnga, a Maari ka bãng-⁠a ye. La a sẽn pʋd a Maari yʋʋrã, a Maari bãngame tɩ yaa a Zezi. A zoeeme n tɩ yeel karen-​biisã yaa: ‘Ad mam yãa Zusoabã!’

Baraarã me, karen-​biis a yiib n da rebd Emayus tɩ rao a ye wa tũud-⁠b n kẽnda. B sẽn kʋ a Zezi wã yĩng kɩtame t’a karen-​biisã sũy ra sãam wʋsgo. La raoã sẽn da tũud-​bã sõsa ne-⁠ba, n togs-⁠b bũmb wʋsg sẽn be Biiblã pʋgẽ, tɩ b sũyã yɩ noogo. La b sẽn wa n yals n na n dɩ wã, karen-​biisã bãngame tɩ sẽn da tũud-⁠a bãmbã yaa a Zezi. Rẽ poore a Zezi menemame, la karen-​biis a yiibã zoee tao-​tao n leb Zerizalɛm n na n tɩ togs tʋm-​tʋmdbã tɩ b yãa a Zezi.

Nand tɩ karen-​biis a yiibã ta Zerizalɛmmã, a Zezi pukame t’a Pɩɛɛr yã-a. Karen-​biis a taabã sẽn wʋm dẽ wã, b sũyã yɩɩ noog wʋsgo. Karen-​biis a yiibã me taa Zerizalɛm n togs tʋm-​tʋmdbã tɩ bãmb me yãa a Zezi. La b sẽn wa n togsdẽ wã, yel-​solemd n maane. Yãmb mii sẽn yɩ bũmb ning bɩ?

Ges-⁠y foto wã. A Zezi karen-​biisã bee roog pʋgẽ. La baa ne roogã sẽn sogã a Zezi puka be. Ad a karen-​biisã sũy segd n yɩɩ noogo! Yãmb sõdame n ges yaa naoor a wãn la a Zezi sẽn vẽneg a meng a vʋʋgrã raar t’a karen-​biisã yã-a wã bɩ? Yaa naoor a nu.

La a Zezi sẽn wa n na n puk roogã pʋgẽ wã tɩ tʋm-​tʋmd a Toma ka be be ye. A sẽn wa wã karen-​biisã yeel-⁠a lame tɩ bãmb yãa a Zezi. La a Toma yeelame tɩ yẽ mengã sã n pa yã a Zezi, a pa na n tẽ ye. Rasem a nii loogr poore, karen-​biisã le tigma taab roog pʋgẽ, n sog roogã. Wakat kãng t’a Toma me ra bee be. Zĩig pʋgẽ bala, a Zezi puka roogã pʋgẽ. A Toma meng sẽn yã-a wã, a tẽeme masã.Zã 20:⁠11-⁠29; Luk 24:⁠13-⁠43. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A ZEZI vʋʋgrã poore, a vẽnega a meng naoor wʋsg n paas t’a karen-​biisã yã-a. Daar a yembr menga, yaa karen-​biis sẽn ta bãmb kobs-⁠nu n naag taab n yã-a. A sã n da vẽneg a menga, yãmb mii a sẽn gomd bũmb ning yell bɩ? Yaa Wẽnnaam rĩungã yelle. Bala a Zeova tʋm-⁠a-⁠la tẽngã zug t’a wa gom rẽ yelle. La a Zezi kell n maana woto baa a vʋʋgrã poor menga.

Yãmb ket n tẽra Wẽnnaam rĩungã sẽn yaa bũmb ning bɩ? Yaa Wẽnnaam goosneema sẽn be saasẽ. Wẽnnaam yãka a Zezi t’a yaa goosneem-​kãng naaba. Wala tõnd sẽn zoe n yã wã, a Zezi rɩlga neba, n sãoog bãad dãmbã, la a vʋʋg neb sẽn ki menga, tɩ woto wilgdẽ t’a na n yɩɩ na-​sõngo.

La a Zezi sã n wa na n dɩ naam yʋʋm tusrã, tẽngã na n yɩɩ wãn to? Tẽngã gill na n yɩɩ arzãna. Zabã, bãasã, bi-​beelmã la kũumã meng ka na n le zĩnd ye. D miime tɩ na n sɩd yɩɩ woto bal kɛpɩ, bala Wẽnnaam naana tẽngã n dat t’a yɩ arzãn tɩ nebã vɩɩmd a zugu. Yaa rẽ n so tɩ sɩngrẽ wã, a maan zĩ-neer ning b sẽn boond tɩ Edɛnnã. A Zezi na n kɩtame tɩ tẽngã yɩ arzãn wa Wẽnnaam sẽn da rat tɩ yɩ to-⁠to wã.

Yaa rasem 40 pʋgẽ la a Zezi sẽn da vẽnegd a meng t’a karen-​biisã yãt-⁠a wã. Rẽ kɩtame tɩ b bãng t’a sɩd vʋʋgame. La masã, a na n leba saasẽ. Nand t’a looge, a yeela a karen-​biisã yaa: ‘Kell-⁠y n pa-⁠y Zerizalɛm hal tɩ ta daar ning y sẽn na n paam vʋʋsem sõngã.’ Yãmb mii vʋʋsem sõngã sẽn yaa bũmb ning bɩ? Yaa Wẽnnaam pãnga. D tõe n mak-⁠a-⁠la ne sebgã. Pãn-​kãng na n sõnga a Zezi karen-​biisã tɩ b maan Wẽnnaam daabã. A Zezi leb n yeel-⁠b lame tɩ b segd n moona koɛɛgã tɩ ta dũniyã tɛk fãa.

A Zezi sẽn yeel woto wã poore, yel-​solemd n maane. A sɩnga zẽkre, n loogd saasẽ. Yãmb pa ne foto wã sɩda? Sawadg n wa n lud a Zezi, t’a karen-​biisã ye pa ne-⁠a ye. A karen-​biisã ra pa na n le yã-a yɛs ye. A Zezi rʋʋ saasẽ, n sɩng naam dɩɩb a karen-​biisã sẽn be tẽng zugã zugu.1 Korẽnt dãmba 15:​3-⁠8; Wilgri 21:​3, 4; Tʋʋma 1:​1-⁠11. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y neb nins sẽn be foto wã zugã. Yaa a Zezi karen-​biisi. B tũu a Zezi goamã n pa Zerizalɛm. B ra tigma taab roog pʋgẽ n gũudẽ. La bʋʋr sẽn yaa kãseng n wa n maane. Ra wõnda seb-​kãseng rãamde. Rẽ poore, bug-​witim n puk karen-​biig fãa zugẽ. Yãmb pa ne bugmã sẽn wit ned kam fãa zugẽ sɩda? La woto fãa rat n yeelame tɩ bõe?

Yaa yel-​solemde. A Zezi sẽn leb saasẽ n be a Ba wã nengẽ wã, a kɩtame tɩ Wẽnnaam vʋʋsem sõngã sig a karen-​biisã zutu. Yãmb mii vʋʋsem sõngã sẽn kɩt tɩ karen-​biisã maan bũmb ning bɩ? B fãa sɩngame n gomd goam buud toor-​toor masã.

Nebã wʋsg sẽn da be Zerizalɛmmã wʋma bʋʋrã n wa n na n gese. Sãamb me n da wa Zerizalɛm n na n maan Israɛll nebã kibs ning b sẽn boond tɩ Pãntekotã. B sẽn wʋm karen-​biisã sẽn da gomd bãmb buudã goam n wilgd Wẽnnaam sẽn maan bũmb ninsã, ling-⁠b-⁠la wʋsgo.

Rẽ n so tɩ b yeel yaa: ‘Nin-​kãensã pa Galile neb sɩda? La maana wãn tɩ b gomd tõnd buudã goamã?’

Dẽ, a Pɩɛɛr yikame n zẽk a koɛɛg n togs b sẽn kʋ a Zezi to-⁠to, la a togs t’a Zeova vʋʋg-⁠a lame. A leb n yeela woto: ‘Masã, a Zezi bee saasẽ, n zĩ Wẽnnaam dɩtgo. La yaa a sẽn kõ tõnd vʋʋsem sõng ning a sẽn da pʋlmã yĩng n kɩt tɩ yãmb ne yel-​soalem kãensã wã.’

A Pɩɛɛr sẽn yeel woto wã, neb wʋsg sũy sãama b sẽn wʋm bũmb ning sẽn paam a Zezi wã. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ b sok-⁠a woto: ‘Bõe la d segd n maane?’ La a Pɩɛɛr leokame yaa: ‘Yãmb segd n toeema y zʋgã la y reeg lisgu.’ Baraarã bala, sẽn na ta neb tus a tã n deeg lisgu, n lebg a Zezi karen-​biisi.Tʋʋma 2:​1-⁠47. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

data.titulo: B yiis- b- la bãens roogẽ
data.contenido:
GES-⁠Y malɛkã sẽn pakd bãensã roogo. Rap nins sẽn yitã yaa a Zezi tʋm-​tʋmdbã. Bɩ d ges bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ b kẽes-⁠b bãensã.

Vʋʋsem sõngã sẽn sig a Zezi karen-​biisã zugã poor bilfu, a Pɩɛɛr ne a Zã yika daar a ye n debd Zerizalɛm wẽnd-​doogẽ wã. B sẽn ta wẽnd-​doogã noorã, b yãa rao sẽn yaa põore. A roga ne a komslmã. Nebã talld-⁠a-⁠la daar fãa n wat wẽnd-​doogã noor t’a bõosd neb nins sẽn wat be wã. A sẽn yã a Pɩɛɛr ne a Zã wã, a bõos-⁠b-⁠la bũmbu. Yãmb mii tʋm-​tʋmdbã sẽn maan bũmb ning bɩ?

B yalsame n ges raoã, t’a Pɩɛɛr yeel yaa: ‘Mam ka tar ligd ye. La mam na n kõo foo bũmb ninga mam sẽn tarã. Ne a Zezi yʋʋre, bɩ f yik n kẽne.’ Dẽ poore, a Pɩɛɛr gãda raoã nug rɩtg n zẽk-⁠a t’a kell n yik n yals yĩngr n sɩng kẽna. Nebã sẽn yã yel-​solemdã, b yɛɛsame la b sũurã yɩɩ noog wʋsgo.

A Pɩɛɛr yeela nebã tɩ yaa ne Wẽnnaam ning sẽn vʋʋg a Zezi wã pãng la yẽ ne a Zã sẽn maan yel-​solem-​kãngã wã. La a Pɩɛɛr ne a Zã sẽn wa n gomdã, Zʋɩf rãmbã tũudmã taoor dãmb kẽer n wa. B sũurã yikame, a Pɩɛɛr ne a Zã sẽn togsd nebã t’a Zezi vʋʋgame wã yĩnga. Rẽ n so tɩ b yõk a Pɩɛɛr ne a Zã n kẽes bãense.

Vẽkembeoogã, tũudmã taoor dãmb wʋsg tigma taaba, n kɩt tɩ b tall a Pɩɛɛre, a Zã ne rao ning b sẽn sãoogã n wa. B soka a Pɩɛɛre ne a Zã yaa: ‘Yaa ne pãn-​bʋg la yãmb sẽn maan yel-​solem-​kãnga wã?’

A Pɩɛɛr leok-⁠b lame tɩ yaa ne Wẽnnaam ning sẽn vʋʋg a Zezi wã pãnga. La maan-​kʋʋdbã ra pa mi b sẽn na n maan bũmb ning ye. Bala bãmb mengã ra yãame t’a Pɩɛɛr ne a Zã tõog n sãooga raoã. Dẽnd b yeela tʋm-​tʋmdbã tɩ b ra le saag n gom a Zezi yell abada. Rẽ poore b bas-⁠b lame tɩ b looge.

La tʋm-​tʋmdbã ra ket n gomda a Zezi yell ne nebã, la b sãoogd bãad dãmbã. Nebã ra gomda yel-​soalem nins b sẽn maandã yell zĩig fãa. La neb wʋsg n da yit tẽns sẽn pa zãr ne Zerizalɛm n wat ne bãad dãmb tɩ tʋm-​tʋmdbã sãoogd-⁠ba. Woto kɩtame tɩ sũ-kiir yõk tũudmã taoor dãmb tɩ b yõg tʋm-​tʋmdbã n kẽes bãense. La tʋm-​tʋmdbã pa kaoos bãensã roogẽ ye.

Baraar yʋng bala, Wẽnnaam malɛk n wa n pak bãensã roogo. Yãmb pa ne fotã zug sɩda? Malɛkã yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Kẽng-⁠y n tɩ yaas-⁠y Wẽnnaam doogã pʋgẽ n kell n moon nebã koɛɛgã.’ Vẽkembeoogã yibeoogo, tũudmã taoor dãmb tʋma neb tɩ b tɩ yiis tʋm-​tʋmdbã bãensã roogẽ n wa, la b tɩ mikame tɩ tʋm-​tʋmdbã ka be ye. B wa n yã-b lame tɩ b be wẽnd-​doogẽ wã n zãmsd nebã, tɩ b tall-⁠b n kẽng Zʋɩf rãmbã bʋ-​kaoodbã ro-​kãseng pʋgẽ.

Tũudmã taoor dãmb yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Tõnd yeela yãmb tɩ y ra le gom a Zezi yell yɛs ye. La yãmb pidsa Zerizalɛm ne y zãmsgã.’ Tʋm-​tʋmdbã yeelame yaa: ‘Tõnd segd n saka Wẽnnaam n yɩɩd ninsaala.’ Dẽnd b kell n moona koe-​noogã n ka bas ye. D segd n dɩka b togs-⁠n-​taare.Tʋʋma sak a 3 n tɩ tãag a 5. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

data.titulo: B loba a Etɩɛn kug n kʋ
data.contenido:
YÃMB sẽn ne rao ning sẽn yĩgã yʋʋr la a Etɩɛn. Yaa a Zezi karen-​biig sẽn sɩd sakd Wẽnnaam ne a sũur fãa. La ges-⁠y bũmb ning sẽn paam-⁠a masã! Rapã lobd-⁠a-⁠la ne kug-​bɛda. La bõe yĩng tɩ b kis a Etɩɛn hal n wa lobd-⁠a kug woto?

Wẽnnaam kɩtame t’a Etɩɛn maan yel-​soalma. La ra-​kãensã ra pa nong rẽ ye. B ra wẽeda no-​koɛɛm ne a Etɩɛn a sẽn zãmsd nebã bũmb ningã zugu. La Wẽnnaam kõo a Etɩɛn yam wʋsgo, t’a tõog n wilg vẽeneg tɩ ra-​kãensã pa togsd sɩd ye. Woto puuga rapã sũy n paase, tɩ b yõk a Etɩɛn la b bao neb n kɩt tɩ b rõd-⁠a.

Maan-​kʋʋdbã kãsmã soka a Etɩɛn yaa: ‘Nebã sẽn gomdã yaa sɩd bɩ?’ A Etɩɛn togsa bũmb ning sẽn be Biiblã pʋgẽ wã. Baasgẽ wã a yeelame tɩ pĩnd wẽndẽ wã me, nin-​wẽns n da kis a Zeova no-​rɛɛsdbã. A le yeela nebã woto: ‘Yãmb me wõnda nin-​kãensã. Yãmb kʋʋ Wẽnnaam tʋm-​tʋmd a Zezi, la yãmb pa tũud Wẽnnaam noyã ye.’

Tũudmã taoor dãmb sẽn wʋm dẽ wã, b sũyã puuga wʋsg hal tɩ b wãbd b yẽnã. La a Etɩɛn zẽka a neng n ges yĩngr n yeel yaa: ‘Ges-⁠y-​yã, mam nee a Zezi sẽn yas Wẽnnaam dɩtgo.’ Rapã sẽn wʋm dẽ n paasã, b yẽda b tʋbã, la b naag taab n yõk-⁠a n veo n yiis tẽngã kɩrenga.

B sẽn ta be wã, b yeesa b futã n kɩs bi-​bɩɩg a Soll t’a gũ. Yãmb pa ne a Soll fotã zug sɩda? Dẽ poore, rapã sɩngame n lobd a Etɩɛn kuga. A Etɩɛn yĩgimdame n pʋʋs Wẽnnaam n yeel yaa: ‘Zeova, da sɩbg-⁠b yel-​kãngã yĩng ye.’ A Etɩɛn da miime tɩ yaa tũudmã taoor dãmb sẽn da belg nebã yĩng la kẽer sẽn sak n lobd yẽ kugã. A sẽn pʋʋs n sa wã, a kiime.

Ned sã n maan yãmb wẽngã, yãmb maanda a soabã n lebs bɩ? Yãmb kota Wẽnnaam t’a sɩbg-⁠a bɩ? A Etɩɛn ne a Zezi pa maan woto ye. B ra nonga neb nins sẽn pa nong-​bã menga. Bɩ d modg n maan wa bãmba.Tʋʋma 6:​8-⁠15; 7:​1-⁠60. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB mii ned ning sẽn gãe tẽngã bɩ? Yaa a Solle. Yaa yẽ n da gũud rap nins sẽn lob a Etɩɛn kugã futu. Yãmb nee vẽenemã sẽn yãgdã bɩ? Yaa bõe n maane?

A Etɩɛn kũumã poore, a Soll namsa a Zezi karen-​biisã wʋsgo. A ra kẽeda zak-​zak n yõgd karen-​biisã n tʋgd n kẽesd bãens roogẽ. Karen-​biisã wʋsg zoeeme n kẽng tẽns a taaba, la b kell n moona koe-​noogã beenẽ. La a Soll me ra ket n gilgda tẽnsã n gẽesd-⁠ba. Daar a yembre, a yikame n debd Damase, la bũmb n tek n maan sorã zugu.

Vẽenem n yi saasẽ zĩig pʋgẽ n gũbg a Soll t’a lʋɩ tẽnga. Yãmb pa ne fotã zug sɩda? Rẽ poore, koɛɛg n yeel yaa: ‘Soll, Soll! Bõe yĩng tɩ fo namsd maam?’ Rap nins sẽn da tũud a Sollã nee vẽenemã la b wʋmd koɛɛgã, la b ka wʋmd goamã võor ye.

A Soll sokame yaa: ‘Yãmb yaa ãnda, Zusoaba?’

Tɩ koɛɛgã leok yaa: ‘Maam la a Zezi, fo sẽn namsd a soabã.’ A Zezi yeela woto, bala a Soll sã n namsd a karen-​biisã yaa wa yẽ mengã la a namsda.

A Soll sokame yaa: ‘Zusoaba, bõe la m segd n maane?’

T’a Zezi yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Yik n kẽng Damase. Fo sã n ta be, ned n na n wilg foo f sẽn segd n maan bũmb ninga.’ A Soll yikame n wok a ninã, la a pa ne bũmb ye. A lebga zoanga. Dẽnd rap nins sẽn da pʋgd-⁠a wã gãda a nugã n na n tall-⁠a n kẽng Damase.

A Zezi yeela a karen-​biig a Ananias sẽn be Damasã woto: ‘Yik n kẽng sor ning sẽn boond tɩ tɩrgã n ta a Zida zakẽ wã n sok rao ning b sẽn boond t’a Sollã yelle. Mam yãka yẽ t’a na n yɩ m tʋm-​tʋmda.’

A Ananias sɩd sakame n kẽnge. A sẽn ta wã, a sɩd yãa a Solle. A sẽn yã-a wã, a tik-⁠a-⁠la ne a nusã n yeel yaa: ‘Zusoabã tʋma maam tɩ m wa kɩt tɩ f ninã puk la f pid ne vʋʋsem sõngo.’ Wakat kãng bala, bũmb sẽn wõnd nod-​pagd n yi a Soll ninẽ wã n lʋɩ, t’a ninã puki, t’a tõe n le yã.

Wẽnnaam kõo a Soll tõog t’a na n moon tẽns wʋsg neba. Yaa yẽ la b sẽn wa n boond tɩ tʋm-​tʋmd a Pollã. D na n goma a yell taoore. La nananda, bɩ d ges Wẽnnaam sẽn tʋm a Pɩɛɛr t’a tɩ maan bũmb ninga.Tʋʋma 8:​1-⁠4; 9:​1-⁠20; 22:​6-⁠16; 26:​8-⁠20. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

data.titulo: A Pɩɛɛr tɩ gesa a Korney
data.contenido:
RAO ning sẽn tees a nugã yaa a Pɩɛɛre, tɩ sẽn yas-⁠b a poorẽ wã yaa a zo-​rãmba. Yãmb mii ned ning sẽn yĩg a Pɩɛɛr taoorã bɩ? A sẽn maanã segdame sɩda? La bõe yĩng meng t’a maand woto?

Sẽn yĩg-⁠a wã yʋʋr la a Korney. Yaa Rom sodaas naaba. A Korney ra pa mi a Pɩɛɛr ye. La koɛɛg n yeel-⁠a t’a bool a Pɩɛɛr t’a wa a zakẽ wã. Bõe yĩnga?

A Zezi pipi karen-​biisã fãa ra yaa Zʋɩf rãmba. A Korney yẽ ra pa Zʋɩf ye. La a ra nonga Wẽnnaam, n pʋʋsd-⁠a wakat fãa, la a maand nebã neere. Daar a yembr zaabre, malɛk n puk a taoor n yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Fo taa Wẽnnaam yam, la a reega f pʋʋsgã. Tʋm neb Zope tɩ b tɩ bool a Pɩɛɛr t’a wa. Yẽ siga a Sɩmo yirã sẽn be ko-​kãsengã noorã.’

Tao-​tao bala, a Korney tʋma neb tɩ b tɩ bool a Pɩɛɛre. Vẽkembeoogã, rap nins a Korney sẽn tʋmã sẽn wa n kolgd Zope wã t’a Pɩɛɛr da bee a Sɩmo roogã zugu. Wẽnnaam maana yel-​solemd t’a Pɩɛɛr yã fu-​goabg sẽn yit saasẽ n sigda. Rũms buud toor-​toor n da be fuugã pʋgẽ. Yaa rũms Wẽnnaam noyã sẽn da gɩdg tɩ b ra wãbe, tɩ bala b yaa rẽgdo. La koɛɛg n yeel a Pɩɛɛr yaa: ‘Yik n kʋ n dɩ.’

La a Pɩɛɛr yeelame yaa: ‘Ayo, mam zɩ n dɩ bõn-​dẽgd ye.’ La koɛɛgã yeela a Pɩɛɛr yaa: ‘Da le bool bũmb ning Wẽnnaam sẽn yeel tɩ yaa sõma wã tɩ rẽgd ye.’ Bõn-​kãngã maana woto naoor a tãabo. A Pɩɛɛr sẽn nan bʋgsd n dat n bãng bũmb ning a sẽn yã wã võorã, la rap nins a Korney sẽn tʋmã sẽn ta zakẽ wã n sok a yelle.

A Pɩɛɛr sigame n yeel-⁠b yaa: ‘Yaa maam la yãmb sẽn baoodã. Bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb baood maam?’ Rapã sẽn togs tɩ malɛk n yeel a Korney t’a bool a Pɩɛɛr t’a wa a zakẽ wã, a Pɩɛɛr sakame. Vẽkembeoogã, a Pɩɛɛr ne a zo-​rãmbã yikame n tũ rapã n kẽng a Korney nengẽ Sezaare.

A Korney ra tigma a zakã neb ne a zo-​rãmba. A Pɩɛɛr sẽn wa n ta wã, a Korney seg-⁠a lame n wõgemd a taoore. Yãmb pa ne rẽnda fotã zug sɩda? La a Pɩɛɛr yeelame yaa: ‘Yik tɩ ma-⁠me yaa ninsaal wa foo.’ Biiblã wilgame tɩ d pa segd n wõgemd n waoog ned wa Wẽnd ye. Yaa a Zeova bal n segd ne waoog-​kãng buudu.

A Pɩɛɛr sɩngame masã n na n togs neb nins sẽn da tigmã koe-​noogã. A yeela woto: ‘Mam bãngame tɩ Wẽnnaam nonga neb nins fãa sẽn dat n tũ yẽ wã.’ A Pɩɛɛr sẽn wa n gomdã, Wẽnnaam kɩtame t’a vʋʋsem sõngã sig nebã zut tɩ b sɩng masã n gomd goam toɛy-​toɛya. Woto linga Zʋɩf nins sẽn da tũ a Pɩɛɛr n wa wã, bala b ra tẽedame tɩ yaa Zʋɩf rãmbã bal la Wẽnnaam nonga. B bãngame masã tɩ Wẽnnaam pa yãk buud a ye neb n yet tɩ bãmb n yaa sõma bɩ bãmb n yɩɩd buud a taabã neb ye. Tõnd fãa me segd n maana wa Wẽnnaam.Tʋʋma 10:​1-⁠48; 11:​1-⁠18; Wilgri 19:⁠10. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

data.titulo: A Poll paama sõngd a to
data.contenido:
BI-​BƖƖG ning sẽn yas ne tʋm-​tʋmd a Pollã yʋʋr la a Tɩmote. A Tɩmote ne a zakã rãmb vɩɩ Listri. A ma wã yʋʋr la a Eniis t’a yaab-​poakã yʋʋr la a Loyiis.

Yaa naoor a tãab-⁠n-​soab la woto a Poll sẽn tɩ ges Listr nebã. Yẽ ne a Barnabas da reng n wa moona koe-​noogã be sẽn na maan yʋʋmd masã. La so-​kãngã wã, yaa yẽ ne a zoa a Sɩlas n lebg n wa.

Yãmb mii a Poll sẽn yet a Tɩmote bũmb ningã bɩ? A sok-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Fo rat n tũu maam ne a Sɩlas bɩ?’ La a yeel-⁠a woto: ‘Fo tõe n sõnga tõnd tɩ d moon neb nins sẽn be zĩ-zãrsã.’

A Tɩmote yeelame tɩ yẽ rat n tũ-b lame. A sɩd basa a zakã rãmb n tũ a Poll ne a Sɩlas. La nand tɩ d gom rẽ yelle, bɩ d reng n gom a Poll yelle. Rat n taa yʋʋm 17 masã la a Zezi sẽn gom ne a Poll Damas sorã zugã.

D tẽeg t’a Poll da rebda Damas n na n tɩ nams a Zezi karen-​biisã, la masã yẽ mengã lebga a Zezi karen-​biiga. Bɛɛb n mak n na n kʋ-⁠a, bala b pa nong a sẽn gomd a Zezi yellã ye. La karen-​biis a taabã sõnga a Poll t’a põse. B kɩtame t’a kẽ peoog pʋgẽ tɩ b sik-⁠a tẽngã lalgã poore.

Dẽ, a Poll kẽngã Ãntios n tɩ moon koɛɛgã. Yaa be la b bool a Zezi karen-​biisã pipi tɩ kiris-​neba. Be, b tʋma a Poll ne a Barnabas tɩ b gilg n moon koɛɛgã zĩ-zãrsẽ. Wala makre, b tũu taab n kẽng a Tɩmote ba-​yirã Listri.

B sẽn yi Listrã tɩ yʋʋmde, a Poll lebg n waa be. Yaa wakat kãng la a Tɩmote sẽn sak n na n tũ a Poll ne a Sɩlasã. Yãmb mii b sẽn tũ taab n kẽng zĩis ninsã bɩ? Ges-⁠y kartã zugu. Pipi, b reng n kẽnga Ikoniyom sẽn pa zãr ne Listrã, n yaool n kẽng Ãntios. Rẽ poore, b kẽnga Torwas, Filipi, Tesalonik la Beere. Yãmb nee Atɛn kartã zug bɩ? A Poll moona koɛɛgã be me. Rẽ poore, b kẽnga Korẽnt n tɩ moon koɛɛgã yʋʋmd a ye la pʋɩ-​sʋka. B sẽn yi Korẽntã b kẽnga Efɛɛz la b pa kaoos be ye. B sẽn yi Efɛɛzã b kẽe batayo n lebg n wa Sezaare, n yi be n kẽng Ãntiose, t’a Poll tɩ pa be.

Dẽnd a Tɩmote toga sor kɩlometr ka tɛk n sõng a Poll tɩ b moon koe-​noogã la b lugl tigimsi. Yãmb sã n wa lebg bedre, yãmb me na n tʋma Wẽnnaam tʋʋmdã sõma wa a Tɩmote bɩ?Tʋʋma 9:⁠19-⁠30; 11:⁠19-⁠26; sak 13 n tɩ tãag 17; 18:​1-⁠22. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

data.titulo: Biig n gũs n yak n lʋɩ
data.contenido:
BÕE n maan biig ning sẽn gãe tẽngã? A yii fenetrẽ n yak n lʋɩ. A wee n pa ki la? Rap a yiib nins sẽn yãgd n wat n na n ges-⁠a wã yaa a Poll ne a Tɩmote.

Yaa Torwas la yel-​kãngã maan-​yã. A Poll ra bee be n sõsd ne karen-​biisã. A ra miime t’a na n kaoosame n yaool n le yã-ba, bala vẽkembeoogã a ra segd n kẽe batayo n kẽng zĩig a to. Yaa rẽ n so t’a sõs ne-⁠b n tãag yʋn-​sʋka.

Bi-​riblã yʋʋr la a Etiisi. A ra zĩi fenetrẽ wã n suusdẽ, n wa sɩng gõeem n kell n yi be n yak n lʋɩ. A yaool n da bee etaas a yiib zĩigẽ. Nebã bee bʋʋm la b sẽn yɛɛsã, bala b sẽn zẽk-⁠a wã b mikame t’a kiime.

A Poll sẽn yã tɩ bi-​riblã kiime wã, a gãand n bʋʋga biigã, n mobg-⁠a la a yeel nebã tɩ b ra yɛɛs tɩ bũmb pa tar-⁠a ye. Sɩd me, a Poll vʋʋga biigã. Ad yɩɩ yel-​solemd tɛkẽ! Nebã sũy yɩɩ noog hal wʋsgo.

Nebã fãa lebg n dʋʋ roogẽ wã n na n dɩ. A Poll kell n sõsame n tãag yibeoogo. La a Etiis pa le saag n gũs koe! Rẽ poore, a Poll ne a Tɩmote la neb nins sẽn da tũud-​bã kẽe batayo n na n tog sore. Yãmb mii b sẽn da rebd zĩig ning bɩ? Yaa naoor a tãab-⁠n-​soab masã la a Poll sẽn gilg tẽnsã n moon koɛɛgã. A sẽn wa n lebg so-​kãngã wã, a tek n yalsa Efɛɛz n maan yʋʋm a tãab tõr be. Rẽ kɩtame tɩ gilgr a tãab-⁠n-​soabã kaoos n yɩɩg yiib-⁠n-​soabã.

Batayo wã yii Torwas n tek n yals Mile bilfu. Efɛɛz sẽn da pa zãr ne Mile wã yĩnga, a Poll boola Efɛɛz tigingã kãsem dãmb tɩ b wa Mile t’a sõs ne-⁠ba, bala a ra pa na n le yã-b yɛs ye. Batayo wã sẽn wa n dat n loogã, kãsem dãmbã sũy sãamame, a Poll sẽn loogdã yĩnga.

Batayo wã wa n taa Sezaare masã. A Poll zĩnda karen-​biig a Filip nengẽ, la no-​rɛɛs a Agabis wa n yeela a Poll t’a sã n kẽng Zerizalɛm, b na n yõk-⁠a lame n kẽes bãense. Sɩd yɩɩ woto. La b reng n kẽesa a Poll bãens yʋʋm a yiib Sezaare, n yaool n na n tall-⁠a n kẽng Rom tɩ Rom naab a Sezaar na n kao a bʋʋdo. Bɩ d ges bũmb ning sẽn maane, b sẽn wa n debd Romã.Tʋʋma sak 19 n tɩ tãag 26. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y batayo wã sẽn bõrd koomã pʋgẽ! Yãmb nee nebã sẽn be koomẽ wã bɩ? Kẽer zoe n paam n yiime. A Poll me paam n yiime. Yãmb ne-⁠a-⁠la fotã zug bɩ? Bɩ d ges bũmb ning sẽn maane.

Tẽeg-⁠y tɩ b ra kẽesa a Poll bãens yʋʋm a yiib Sezaare. La rẽ poore, b kɩtame tɩ yẽ ne bi-​bees a wãn kẽ batayo n na n kẽng Rom. B sẽn wa n yõsgd Kɛrɛtã, seb-​kẽeng n yiki. Sebgã ra fugda wʋsg hal tɩ rapã pa tõe n wẽn batayo wã meng ye. Wĩndgã ra pukdame n tãag a kõom tɩ b pa tol n yã-a ye. Yʋng me b ra pa tõe n yã ãdsã ye. Sẽn kaoos rasem wʋsgã yĩnga, neb nins sẽn da be batayo wã pʋgẽ wã wa n tẽedame tɩ b fãa na n kiime.

La a Poll yikame n yeel yaa: ‘Yãmb ned ba a yembr ka na n ki ye, yaa batayo wã bal n na n sãame, bala Wẽnnaam malɛk n wa mam nengẽ yʋngã n yeel maam yaa: “Polle, ra zoe rabeem ye, yaa tɩlae tɩ fo ta Rom naab a Sezaar nengẽ. La gese, Wẽnnaam na n fãaga foo ne neb nins fãa sẽn be batayo wã pʋgẽ wã.” ’

Sebgã sẽn sɩngã taa rasem 14 masã. Rasem piig la a naas raarã yʋn-​sʋka, batayo wã rãmb yãame tɩ koomã boogdame. Zĩigã sẽn da yaa lik tɩ b yɛɛsd tɩ batayo wã na n tɩ fãoo pĩigã yĩnga, b loba kud-​zɩsd a naas sẽn loe ne sɛn dãmb koomã pʋgẽ tɩ tʋg n sud tẽnga. Vẽkembeoogã, b yãa mogrã rʋʋnd tɩ b mak n na n ta be.

La b sẽn wa n kolgd rʋʋndã, batayo wã rʋʋ kunkubr n ka ye tõe n loog ye. Mogrã koom pem-⁠a lame t’a sɩng sãango. Sodaas naab ning sẽn da get-⁠a bi-​beesã yellã yeelame yaa: ‘Bɩ neb nins sẽn mi rugbã reng n kẽ koomẽ wã n dug n ta tẽngã, tɩ neb a taabã sẽn kellã gãd koglgã ra-​pegdã n paam n dug n yi.’ B sɩd maana woto tɩ neb kobs-⁠yi la pis-​yopoe la a yoob nins sẽn da be batayo wã pʋgẽ wã fãa põse. Sɩd yɩɩ wa malɛkã sẽn da yeelã.

B sẽn sig tẽng ningã yʋʋr la Malte. Beenẽ nebã yaa nin-​sõma. B gesa neb nins sẽn da be batayo wã pʋgẽ wã yell neere. Sebgã sẽn wa n yõkã, b kẽesa a Poll batayo a to pʋgẽ t’a na n kẽng Rom.Tʋʋma 27:​1-⁠44; 28:​1-⁠14. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

RAO ning nus sẽn sẽb ne bãensã yaa a Polle. B yõk-⁠a lame n pag Rom la b kɩt tɩ sodaag gũud-⁠a. A Poll gũudame tɩ Rom naab a Sezaar wa bʋ-⁠a. Baa ne b sẽn pag-⁠a wã, b sakdame tɩ neb wat n get-⁠a.

A Poll sẽn ta Rom tɩ rasem a tãab poore, a tʋmame tɩ b tɩ bool Zʋɩf rãmbã taoor dãmb tɩ b wa yẽ nengẽ. Rom Zʋɩf rãmb wʋsg sɩd waame t’a Poll gom a Zezi yelle, la Wẽnnaam rĩungã yell ne-⁠ba. Kẽer tẽeme n lebg kiris-​neba, la kẽer pa tẽ ye.

A Poll moona sodaas nins sẽn da gũud-⁠b yẽ wã me. A Poll sẽn zĩnd roogẽ yʋʋm a yiibã fãa, a moona neb nins fãa sẽn wa n ges-⁠a be wã. Rẽ kɩtame tɩ baa a Sezaar zakã rãmb wʋm Wẽnnaam rĩungã koe-​noogo, tɩ kẽer meng lebg kiris-​neba. La yaa ãnd la sẽn zĩ n gʋlsdẽ wã? Yaa a Tɩmote. B ra kẽesa yẽ me bãens roogẽ koe-​moonegã yĩnga, la masã b yiis-⁠a lame t’a wa n na n sõng a Polle. Yãmb mii a Tɩmote sẽn gʋlsd bũmb ningã bɩ?

Yãmb ket n tẽra Filip ne Efɛɛz tẽnsã yell bɩ? Yaa kibar 110 soabã pʋgẽ la d gom b yelle. A Poll sõngame n lugl tigims tẽn-​kãensã pʋsẽ. La a sẽn be bãens masã wã, a gʋlsda kiris-​neb nins sẽn be beenẽ wã. Lɛta nins a sẽn gʋlsã bee Biiblã pʋgẽ. Yaa Efɛɛz rãmb sebrã la Filip rãmb sebrã. Dẽnd fotã zugã, a Poll togsda a Tɩmote a sẽn segd n gʋls bũmb ning n tool b zo-​rãmb nins sẽn yaa kiris-​neb n be Filipã.

Filip kiris-​nebã maana a Poll neer wʋsgo. B toola a Poll kũun hal bãensã roogẽ, t’a Poll gʋlsd n na n pʋʋs-⁠b barka. Yaa a Epafordit n tall kũunã n kẽnge. La a sẽn wa n ta be wã, a bẽeme hal n da na n ki. La a yĩnsã sãoome masã t’a na n leb Filipi. A na n zãa lɛtr ning a Poll sẽn kɩt t’a Tɩmote gʋlsã n tɩ kõ Filip kiris-​nebã.

A Poll zĩnda bãensã roogẽ n gʋls lɛta a yiib n paase. Lɛtr a ye yɩɩ Kolos kiris-​nebã yĩnga. Yãmb mii b sẽn boond seb-​kãngã to-⁠to Biiblã pʋgẽ bɩ? B boondame tɩ Kolos rãmb sebre. A gʋlsa lɛtr a to wã n tool a zoa a Filemo me sẽn da be Kolosã. Lɛtrã pʋgẽ, a gomda a Filemo yamb a Onezim yelle.

A Onezim soos n yiime n zoe n kẽng Rom. A zĩnda Rom n wʋm t’a Poll bee bãens roogẽ be. A sẽn wʋm dẽ wã, a kẽnga a Poll nengẽ t’a moon-⁠a koɛɛgã. Rẽ poor bilfu, a Onezim lebga kiris-​neda. A sẽn zoe n bas a zu-​soabã sãamda a sũurã masã. La yãmb mii a Poll sẽn gʋls a Filemo n yeel bũmb ning bɩ?

A Poll gʋlsame n bõos a Filemo t’a kõ a Onezim sugri. A yeel-⁠a-⁠la woto: ‘Mam tʋmda a Onezim fo nengẽ. Da reeg-⁠a wa f yamb bal ye. Reeg-⁠a wa f ba-⁠bi-​nongr me.’ A Onezim sẽn wa n na n leb Kolosã, a zãa lɛtr ning a Poll sẽn gʋls Kolos kiris-​nebã, la lɛtr ning a sẽn gʋls a Filemo wã me n kẽnge. A Filemo sẽn bãng t’a yambã lebga kiris-​nedã, a sũurã yɩɩ noog wʋsgo.

A Poll sẽn gʋls Filip nebã la a Filemo wã, a togs-⁠b-⁠la kiba-​noodo. A yeela Filip nebã yaa: ‘Mam na n tʋma a Tɩmote t’a wa yãmb nengẽ, la mam meng na n wa ges-⁠y-⁠la ka la bilfu.’ A yeela a Filemo me yaa: ‘Segl gãag zĩig fo zakẽ wã mam yĩnga.’

B sẽn wa n yiis a Poll bãensã, a gilga tẽns wʋsg n ges a tẽed-⁠n-​taasã. La b le wa n yõk-⁠a lame n kẽes roog Rom yɛsa. A bãngame tɩ so-​kãngã a na n kiime. Rẽ n so t’a gʋls n yeel a Tɩmote t’a wa tao-​tao. A lɛtrã pʋgẽ, a yeela woto: ‘Mam tũu Wẽnnaam sõma, la a na n kõo maam keoore.’ B sẽn kʋ a Pollã yʋʋm a wãn poore, sodaas n leb n wa sãam Zerizalɛm tẽngã, la so-​kãngã yaa Rom sodaase.

La kibay a taab me n be Biiblã pʋgẽ. A Zeova kɩtame tɩ tʋm-​tʋmd a Zã gʋls Biiblã sɛb kẽer tɩ Wilgr sebrã be sʋka. Wilgr sebrã gomda bũmb nins sẽn na n wa maan ka la bilfã yelle.
